title: Canonical ordinary source descent and ordered counit coordinates
statement: Fix the finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], a Noetherian scheme $Y$ over its field, and an ordinary coefficient complex $K$. For the ordered affine tower [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data], construct its canonical source-descent isomorphism by dependent recursion: at rank zero use the inverse tensor-unit trace and identity pullback; at rank $d+1$ use affine-line descent, shifted Tate pullback, tensor associativity and inverse-image composition. Uniqueness is equality of the hom components. Compose this with the canonical tensor-pullback and coefficient-pullback isomorphisms to obtain the coefficient source on the tower itself. On bounded finite-Tor $K$, transport the actual ordered adjunction counit by the normalized bounded-below compact-support comparison. For any compactifiable $f:X\to Y$, coefficient $W$, source $J$, source isomorphism $e:J\cong f^*K\otimes W$, counit $z:Rf_!J\to K$ and trace $t:Rf_!W\to A_Y$, define its coefficient-counit equation as $\operatorname{PF}_f\,Rf_!(e^{-1})\,z=(1_K\otimes t)\rho$. All maps retain their original constructions.

mathlib_searches.results: One hit: CategoryTheory.Adjunction.comp_counit_app in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Adjunction.Basic. It expands the composite counit but does not identify the normalized geometric projection or source-descent maps.

mathlib_searches.query: The coefficient counit of the identity adjunction is tensor with its unit trace and the counit of composed adjunctions propagates this formula by induction
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Adjunction.comp_counit, comp_counit_app, id_counit and monoidal counit facts. These are abstract identities, without the canonical compact-support, finite Tate and coefficient-descent comparisons.

Five Mathlib hits in symbolic dynamics, tactic simps, Dold-Kan and transfinite composition; no compact-support projection or finite coefficient counit formula. Project search found the existing composite-counit, ordinary projection-composition and ordered-affine construction modules, reused here.

lean.statement:
def ordinarySourceDescent (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule A Y) : (d : ℕ) →
    (Etale.affineTraceRight A N hA Y d).obj K ≅
      (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceProjection Y d)).obj
        (((Etale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).obj K).obj
          (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA Y d))
